Eyeliner sharp enough to cut, hearts still healing from 2007 🖤⚡ Les-Be-Emo is crashing the Patio and turning it into your old teenage bedroom — the one with the band posters and the diary you swore no one would read. Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hosts a lineup of queens serving grunge glam and emo nostalgia like it never left. Live bands, a night market, and a drag show that hits different when the bass drops like a breakup text. This is the mini feastival Pasco didn't know it needed. Come mourn your exes together. 💔🎸

📅 Saturday, August 22 — Drag Show at 8:00 PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10
🔞 18+ till 10
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #LesBeEmo #DragShowPasco #EmberRexiaRomanoff #LatinxNightlife #PascoWA #EmoNight

Smells like hairspray and heartbreak 🖤 The lights dim red and black, guitars wail from a live band somewhere close, and the Patio turns into a shrine to every emo phase you swore you outgrew. Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff walks it out like she owns the scene kid crown, and the queens behind her? Pure chaos in eyeliner and fishnets. Feel the bass rattle your ribs, feel the nostalgia hit somewhere between a mosh pit and a heartbreak playlist. Wander the night market between sets, let the fog machine do its thing, and let the whole night feel like 2007 never ended. 🎸💋

Bring your ripped fishnets, your old band tees, your best raccoon eyeliner — everybody's welcome in this scene 🖤✨ Les-Be-Emo is a lesbian music and arts mini feastival built for anyone who ever cried to a breakup playlist in a Hot Topic parking lot. Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hosts, live bands shake the Patio, a night market lines the walkway, and a full drag show turns nostalgia into a whole event. No judgment, no dress code police — just your people, your music, your night. Come as emo as you want. Come as you are. 💜🎤

Mark it down, emo kids — Les-Be-Emo takes over the Patio this Saturday 🖤📅 It's a lesbian music and arts mini feastival with live bands, a night market, and a drag show hosted by Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hitting the stage at 8PM sharp. Grunge glam, teenage bedroom nostalgia, and queens ready to serve every emo era all in one night. Doors open, the market's out, the bands are loud, and the drag show closes it out in style. Get there early, stay for all of it. 🎸💔
